path.description: Path to the source JSONL dataset.
path.title: Path

output_path.description: Where to write the redacted JSONL dataset.
output_path.title: Output Path

backend.description: 'auto' (presidio if installed, else regex) | 'regex' | 'regexset' (single-pass re2, [fastpii] extra) | 'presidio' | 'cascade'.
backend.title: Backend

preset.description: Ready-made redaction configuration; settings below override it. 'governed' (default) = NER + regex + secrets (redacts names, locations, emails, phones, cards, API keys). 'logs' = regex + secrets only (no name/location redaction) — faster/lighter, for log/trace data. Redaction always processes every row (it cannot sample).
preset.title: Preset

ner.description: Redact names & locations (PERSON/LOCATION/ORGANIZATION) via the language model. OFF = redact only pattern PII (emails, phones, cards, secrets) — faster/lighter but names are left in. Keep ON for training data. null = preset's value.
ner.title: Ner

model.description: spaCy model used to find names/locations to redact (ignored when NER is off). 'sm' = fast, ~550 MB; 'lg' = highest recall, ~1.2-1.7 GB; 'blank' = no NER. null = preset's model.
model.title: Model

n_process.description: CPU workers sharing the redaction pass. 0 = auto (all cores; ~40% faster on 2 CPUs). 1 = single process (lowest RAM). Capped at the core count. null = preset's value.
n_process.title: N Process

analyze_chunk.description: Rows fed to the detector at once. Larger = parallel workers stay busy; smaller = less memory. ~2048 is a good default. null = preset's value.
analyze_chunk.title: Analyze Chunk

kinds.description: Subset of recognizers/entities to redact (default: all).
kinds.title: Kinds

text_fields.description: Top-level field name(s) holding the training TEXT to redact (e.g. ['source_text'] or ['messages']). null = auto: redact free-text leaves in every field, skipping short whitespace-free strings (tokens, labels, ids, chat roles) so a tokenized/labelled dataset isn't NER'd per token (#1021). Non-selected fields are copied through untouched.
text_fields.title: Text Fields
